title: Draw & Guess!
lines: Draw & Guess!

Memories scattered across the vast Terra as Doctors and Operators left their trails in the battles against Oripathy and injustice, preserved as one frame and another inside our hearts. This time, we have our great artist, Dusk, to thank for lending her unfathomable brush, allowing us to revivify those moments from the past 2 years. Come to learn your 'lesson' on Discord and see if you can name them all!
Duration
How to Participate
Please join our official Discord Channel at https://discord.gg/arknights first if you haven’t yet.

(Since the Draw&Guess event will be held on our Discord channel, Doctors will have to become its members first to participate in the event. We also recommend verifying your identity for your Discord account in advance as it is required by Discord for sending messages on the channel)
The Draw&Guess event will be held on the sub-channel #draw-and-guess under the category 2ND ANNIVERSARY EVENTS .

By entering the mentioned channel during the event period, doctors would be automatically validated as participants. Our host, from ArknightsEN staff, will announce the detailed rules once again within #server-news , #event-discussion , and #draw-and-guess before the game starts.

The game will be held for 15 rounds . Each round, ArknightsEN staff will start drawing once the game starts and hint at the length and category of the answer. Participants can give out their answers in the event channel in the form of:
/akdraw <answer> (Please note that Angle brackets not included; For example: /akdraw Arknights)

Each round will take around 3 minutes , and the first participant to give out the correct answer will be awarded as the "Kal'tsitist" (one for each of 15 rounds). Moreover, there will be 10 "Myrtle's Favored" awarded at random every 3 rounds of "Arknights Draw&Guess", making them 50 in total.
Note
Guesses from participants will be received as case-insensitive . However, please make sure that space(s) and special character(s) within the guesses match those of the in-game terms
Each participant can take AT MOST 5 GUESSES each round. After a participant’s chances run out, their following guesses will not be received or recorded by the system until the round ends
Once a participant’s guess is received and verified as the correct answer, their following guesses will not be received or recorded by the system until the round ends

The guesses are auto-deleted by the bot to avoid congestion. Due to Discord's limitation, however, this action may be delayed but the guesses will still be recorded by the system if the command is correctly used.
Rewards
Kal'tsitist *15
$30 Gift Card
Myrtle's Favored *50
$10 Gift Card
Rules
Participants must follow the established rules in Arknights official Discord channel during the event. Violating the rules will result in warnings or penalties.

Arknights EN will keep a record of all the successfully submitted answers. Please contact us via arknights.event@yo-star.com or official customer service if you have any questions or problems regarding the results of the game.

Winners will be announced on our social media pages and our Discord channel within 3 working days after the event concludes. The exact reward distribution time and method will be informed by our official customer service staff via Discord DM . Please enable the DM on Discord to ensure that you will not miss the notification.
Please take care of your private information. ArknightsEN is not responsible for any loss caused by mishandled private information.
Please note that each participant is limited to one award per event, and only the prize of the highest worth will be awarded if a participant wins multiple prizes
ArknightsEN reserves the final explanation of the event.
